r.정치 구도: A federal presidential republic in which the president serves a four-year term and may be re-elected once. From the mid-20th century the Peronist movement, built on trade unions and welfare, dominated politics, and under the military dictatorship of 1976 to 1983 thousands of people were disappeared. After repeated bouts of high inflation and debt crises, a libertarian outsider promising to shrink the state won the presidency in 2023. The new government cut ministries, subsidies and public spending sharply, produced a budget surplus and brought inflation down from over 200%. The ruling party won the October 2025 midterm elections and greatly expanded its seats, and in February 2026 Congress passed a labor reform loosening employment rules. Unions say it weakens the right to strike and worker protections, and with the 2027 presidential election approaching, the question is whether the reforms improve people's daily lives.

t.why: It grows soybeans, corn and beef on the vast Pampas and holds a large share of world food markets. With Chile and Bolivia it forms the 'lithium triangle', and as Vaca Muerta's shale oil and gas grow, it has emerged as a destination for resource investment. It is the IMF's largest borrower, so bailout conditions and repayment schedules are constantly in the news. The current government has moved close to Washington: in 2025 the US Treasury propped up the peso with a $20 billion currency swap line, and in 2026 the two countries signed a trade and investment agreement. It fought a war with Britain over the Falkland Islands in 1982 and still claims them. Together with Brazil it anchors the Mercosur trade bloc, and it also claims part of Antarctica.
t.rel: It fought a war with Britain over the Falkland Islands in 1982 and still presses its claim. With Brazil it is at the core of Mercosur, the South American common market.
t.korea: Diplomatic relations were established in February 1962. A Korean community grew after the first group of Korean emigrants arrived in Buenos Aires in 1965, and today around 20,000 people of Korean descent live mainly in the capital, many in the clothing business. In 2018 POSCO bought lithium rights at the Hombre Muerto salt flat in the northwest and built a lithium plant there, 4,000 meters above sea level. Interest from Korean companies is growing because of lithium and other battery minerals.
t.know: Ushuaia is called the southernmost city in the world, and many ships leave from there for Antarctica.
etext: The rich soil of the Pampas produces soybeans, corn, wheat and beef on a vast scale. It is the world's largest exporter of soybean meal and soybean oil. When drought hits, exports and foreign-currency earnings fall together.

Vaca Muerta holds some of the world's largest shale oil and gas resources, turning an energy importer into an exporter. Salt flats in the northwestern highlands are rich in lithium and are drawing foreign investment. A 2024 regime offering tax and foreign-exchange incentives for large investments is designed to pull in such projects.
A well-educated workforce exports knowledge services such as software, design and media content. MercadoLibre, Latin America's largest e-commerce company, was founded in Argentina.

Governments have repeatedly printed money to cover deficits, sending inflation soaring and the currency collapsing time and again. As a result people try to save in dollars, and foreign-exchange reserves are chronically short. A record of nine sovereign defaults keeps borrowing costs high.
